name: prov-o
label: PROV-O (Data Provenance)
description: W3C data provenance ontology — track lineage and origin of any data artifact
short_description: W3C data provenance ontology — track lineage and origin of any data artifact
long_description: W3C PROV-O (Provenance Ontology) provides a universal model for recording the provenance (lineage, origin, history) of data — who created it, what processes transformed it, which sources it derived from, and when each change occurred. The schema implements the PROV core: entities (data artifacts), activities (processes), agents (people/systems), and their relationships.
when_to_use: Use for data governance platforms, scientific reproducibility tools, regulatory audit trails, AI/ML model lineage tracking, or any system where data trust requires documented origins. Required for FDA 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance, GDPR Article 5 accountability, and ISO 27001 change management. Essential for MLOps platforms tracking model training provenance.

table_notes.prov_entity: Represents a PROV Entity: any data artifact, file, dataset, or digital object whose provenance is being tracked.
table_notes.prov_agent: Represents a PROV Agent: a person, software system, or organisation responsible for an activity or entity.
table_notes.prov_activity: Represents a PROV Activity: a process or transformation that occurred over a time interval, consuming and producing entities.
table_notes.prov_was_generated_by: Association linking an entity to the activity that produced it (prov:wasGeneratedBy). Records the exact generation timestamp and optional role.
table_notes.prov_used: Association linking an activity to an entity it consumed as input (prov:used). Records the usage timestamp and optional role.
table_notes.prov_was_attributed_to: Associates an entity with the agent that is responsible for it (prov:wasAttributedTo), with an optional role qualifier.
table_notes.prov_was_derived_from: Records that one entity was derived from another (prov:wasDerivedFrom), including the derivation subtype (e.g. revision, quotation, primary source).

prov_entity.name: id
prov_entity.description: Surrogate primary key for internal references

prov_entity.name: uri
prov_entity.description: Globally unique IRI identifying this entity (e.g. http://example.org/data/file-v1)

prov_entity.name: label
prov_entity.description: Human-readable display name for the entity

prov_entity.name: entity_type
prov_entity.description: PROV subtype of entity: e.g. prov:Plan, prov:Collection, or a domain-specific class

prov_entity.name: location
prov_entity.description: Physical or logical location of the artifact (file path, S3 URL, database URI, etc.)

prov_entity.name: format
prov_entity.description: MIME type or format identifier of the artifact (e.g. text/csv, application/parquet)

prov_entity.name: generated_at
prov_entity.description: Timestamp when the entity came into existence (prov:generatedAtTime)

prov_entity.name: invalidated_at
prov_entity.description: Timestamp when the entity ceased to be valid or usable (prov:invalidatedAtTime)

prov_agent.name: id
prov_agent.description: Surrogate primary key for internal references

prov_agent.name: uri
prov_agent.description: Globally unique IRI identifying this agent (e.g. mailto:user@example.org)

prov_agent.name: label
prov_agent.description: Human-readable display name for the agent (person name or system name)

prov_agent.name: agent_type
prov_agent.description: PROV agent subtype: prov:Person, prov:Organization, or prov:SoftwareAgent

prov_agent.name: email
prov_agent.description: Contact email address for human agents (RFC 5321 max length)

prov_activity.name: id
prov_activity.description: Surrogate primary key for internal references

prov_activity.name: uri
prov_activity.description: Globally unique IRI identifying this activity (e.g. http://example.org/runs/etl-2024-01)

prov_activity.name: label
prov_activity.description: Human-readable description of what the activity did

prov_activity.name: activity_type
prov_activity.description: Domain-specific classification of the activity (e.g. ETL, ModelTraining, FileUpload)

prov_activity.name: ended_at
prov_activity.description: Timestamp when the activity completed (prov:endedAtTime); NULL if still running

prov_was_generated_by.name: entity_id
prov_was_generated_by.description: The entity that was produced; references prov_entity.id

prov_was_generated_by.name: activity_id
prov_was_generated_by.description: The activity that produced the entity; references prov_activity.id

prov_was_generated_by.name: at_time
prov_was_generated_by.description: Exact moment of generation within the activity's time span

prov_was_generated_by.name: party_role
prov_was_generated_by.description: Role the entity played in the generation relationship (e.g. output, primaryOutput)

prov_used.name: activity_id
prov_used.description: The activity that consumed the entity; references prov_activity.id

prov_used.name: entity_id
prov_used.description: The entity consumed as input by the activity; references prov_entity.id

prov_used.name: at_time
prov_used.description: Exact moment the entity was accessed or consumed within the activity

prov_used.name: party_role
prov_used.description: Role the entity played in this usage (e.g. input, trainingData, configFile)

prov_was_attributed_to.name: entity_id
prov_was_attributed_to.description: The entity being attributed to an agent; references prov_entity.id

prov_was_attributed_to.name: agent_id
prov_was_attributed_to.description: The agent responsible for the entity; references prov_agent.id

prov_was_attributed_to.name: party_role
prov_was_attributed_to.description: Role the agent held in relation to the entity (e.g. author, owner, curator)

prov_was_derived_from.name: derived_entity_id
prov_was_derived_from.description: The newly derived entity (the result); references prov_entity.id

prov_was_derived_from.name: source_entity_id
prov_was_derived_from.description: The source entity the derived entity was produced from; references prov_entity.id

prov_was_derived_from.name: derivation_type
prov_was_derived_from.description: PROV derivation subtype: prov:Revision, prov:Quotation, or prov:PrimarySource
